subject: Redacting customer information when hide_user_data_from_log is true in rdb.c, networking.c, debug.c and t_hash  (#3872)
reason: Every hunk only alters the text of a server log message (serverLog/serverLogHexDump/rdbReportCorruptRDB) based on hide-user-data-from-log, redacting the user's key name, consumer-group name, query-buffer bytes, or listpack hexdump. The surrounding control flow is identical on both branches: keys are still saved or rejected the same way, RESTORE still returns the static "Bad data format" reply (rdbReportError in RESTORE context only logs at VERBOSE and returns), the over-limit client is still freed, and serverPanic still fires for duplicate-key and listpack-corruption regardless of the config.
